user.title: Orbitarium
user.description: Choose which satellite groups to load from CelesTrak. Positions are calculated locally for your Home Assistant location. Starlink alone has more than eleven thousand satellites.

data.tracked_satellites: Pass predictions for (NORAD ids, comma separated)

data_description.groups: Rocket bodies and Debris add spent rocket stages and fragments (about 12,500 objects together). They are drawn as small dots; debris is never counted as visible.
data_description.tracked_satellites: 25544 = ISS, 48274 = Tiangong, 20580 = Hubble. Each id gets a 'next visible pass' sensor and a 'visible now' binary sensor.
data_description.min_elevation: Passes lower than this above the horizon are ignored.

error.no_groups: Select at least one satellite group.
error.invalid_norad: Use numeric NORAD catalogue ids separated by commas.

satellite_lost.title: {name} is no longer listed at CelesTrak
satellite_lost.description: CelesTrak has had no orbital data for {name} (NORAD {norad}) for more than a day. The satellite has probably re-entered or been retired, or the NORAD id is wrong. Remove the id from the Orbitarium options to stop tracking it. This message disappears by itself if the satellite is listed again.
